sloka: निर्धूत पत्र शिखराः शीर्ण पुष्प फल द्रुमाः ।निक्षिप्त वस्त्र आभरणा धूर्ता इव पराजिताः ॥५-१४-१५॥
transliteration: nirdhūta patra śikharāḥ śīrṇa puṣpa phala drumāḥ ।nikṣipta vastra ābharaṇā dhūrtā iva parājitāḥ ॥5-14-15॥

translations.english: The tree tops, shorn of their leaves and flowers and fruits fallen, appeared like gamblers who had lost their stakes and had to lay down their clothes and ornaments.
